title: Commits to this repository by hour, October 14–18, 2026
caption: Every commit to this repository since the first one on October 14 at 12:11, by hour of the day, Denver time. 73 commits, 17 pull requests, 22,150 lines added and 1,439 removed, in 12 sittings over 93 hours. The busiest hour was 3 pm on October 16: 19 commits.
method: git log of alternatekev/alternate-viewsource, main plus the branch these words were written on, read October 18 at 09:50; author dates bucketed by hour of the day in America/Denver; merge commits counted as commits; lines counted from the non-merge commits; sittings are runs of commits less than 45 minutes apart, as for the racing rig; sessions counted from the Claude-Session trailer on the commits that carry one.
